lastCompletedStory.title: Isolate the five root-level plan-runner test files onto the plan fixture

nextStoryContext:
US-008 (CAM-420) completed the frozen plan-side census by applying the audit F-03 configPath-fixture-isolation idiom to the five root-level plan-runner test files named in the story's notes (frozen list, not re-derived by grep): test/plan-runner-target-invalid.test.ts (331 lines, makeBaseOpts builder), test/plan-runner-no-prd.test.ts (296 lines, makePlannerfailedOpts builder), test/plan-runner-in-progress-conflict.test.ts (197 lines, baseOpts builder), test/plan-runner-target-prompt.test.ts (285 lines, builder-less, 5 inline runPlanPhase call sites), test/plan-runner-clear-stale.test.ts (103 lines, builder-less, 1 inline call site). Each file got its own module-level GENERIC_PLAN_CONFIG_PATH fixture (own mkdtempSync dir with a distinct prefix per file, `[backend]
planner = "claude"
auditor = "claude"
` project.toml, afterAll cleanup) mirroring US-006/US-007 of this same PRD exactly. The three builder-based files (target-invalid, no-prd, in-progress-conflict) got the exact loop.test.ts idiom `configPath: 'configPath' in overrides ? overrides.configPath : GENERIC_PLAN_CONFIG_PATH,` placed AFTER the `...overrides` spread inside their respective builders (makeBaseOpts, makePlannerfailedOpts, baseOpts). Each of these three files ALSO has one or more inline (non-builder-routed) runPlanPhase/runPlanPhaseWithReplan call sites that bypass the builder entirely (target-invalid's AC3 explicit-target-wins test, no-prd's backward-compat absent-readPlannerReportFn test, in-progress-conflict's re-plan-non-refire replanOpts literal) -- each of those got a direct `configPath: GENERIC_PLAN_CONFIG_PATH` sibling key for full-file isolation, beyond what AC1's oracle strictly required (grep only checks for the idiom string's presence, not full coverage), since correctness was the actual goal. The two builder-less files (target-prompt: 5 call sites, clear-stale: 1 call site) got a literal `configPath: GENERIC_PLAN_CONFIG_PATH` sibling key added to every inline opts object per audit F-03 alternative (a), satisfying the derived-comparand oracle (fixture-usage count == runPlanPhase/runPlanPhaseWithReplan call-site count) exactly: 5==5 and 1==1. RunPlanPhaseOptions.configPath and RunPlanPhaseWithReplanOptions (extends it) already existed as a DI seam from US-002 of this PRD (CAM-420) and thread into readPhaseBackend('planner'|'auditor', configPath)/resolvePhaseModel inside plan-runner.ts, so this story was pure test-fixture wiring, zero src/ changes -- identical shape to US-006/US-007. Verification: the five files individually run 40 pass / 0 fail; full `bun test` unchanged at 5633 pass / 0 fail (no tests added/removed, fixture wiring only); `bun run typecheck` clean; `bun run check:all` fully green with NO file-size-budget.json ceiling raise needed (each file's growth of ~15-25 lines from the fixture block stayed under its existing budget or the file was never budgeted). This closes the audit's frozen plan-side census for test/ root (US-003 through US-008 of this PRD collectively cover all plan-phase call sites the audit identified in scope); any future story adding a NEW runPlanPhase/runPlanPhaseWithReplan call site with an inline (non-builder-routed) opts literal in any of these 5 files must add its own configPath: GENERIC_PLAN_CONFIG_PATH sibling key to keep the isolation intact.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure test-fixture DI-isolation story, mirroring US-003 through US-007 of this same PRD exactly: no new external library surface introduced. RunPlanPhaseOptions.configPath already existed (US-002 of this PRD) and was already wired into readPhaseBackend/resolvePhaseModel for the planner and auditor phases; this story only threaded the pre-existing seam into five more plan-phase test files (three via the overrides idiom plus their inline call sites, two via literal defaults on every inline opts literal).
